proposal_scope: Common design proposal only. No source selection, bank generation, fitting, truth opening, or scientific freeze has occurred.

starting_resource.selection_rule: Use this published selected state; do not choose initialization from fresh answers or TRR-0010 evaluation truth.

ownership_and_boundaries.agent_one: Directional readout implementation and fits; owns this common-contract proposal.
ownership_and_boundaries.agent_two: Nested public fitting-bank preparation and fixed-readout data-scaling controls.
ownership_and_boundaries.shared_artifacts: Public preparation artifacts are read-only across worktrees and bound by exact path, size, and SHA-256.
ownership_and_boundaries.forbidden: No P03 holdout, private study workspace/results, active-registry edits, paid compute, or truth-driven selection.
ownership_and_boundaries.truth_boundary: Freeze source identities, fit/validation roles, model outputs, thresholds, and the final panel before one common natural-evaluation truth opening.

arms.role: data-scaling control with equal optimizer opportunities

crossed_design.a1_a2_comparators: A1 and A2 identities, code, and state receipts must be bound by root/A2 before final evaluation; A2 is an evaluation comparator only and is never deployed.

current.source: Nested subset of the published TRR-0009 improved public fitting bank.
current.current_controlled_replacement_requireme: If replacement sampling is used, A2 must report at least 128 controlled replacement draws and exact draw semantics before freeze.

expanded.construction_and_accounting_note: A2 must bind whether the expanded bank preserves the current mixture or appends natural rows; any mixture change is a data-factor deviation, not silently called pure coverage.

construction_and_accounting.natural_only_append_warning: If expanded preparation can only append natural rows on top of the current bank, report the data factor as coverage-plus-mixture rather than pure coverage.

sampling_requirements: Expanded rows must be new unique public examples with varied token identities and contexts, not repetitions or a replacement mixture of the same size.
Fit-bank rows are excluded from the final natural panel, public validation panel, and known train/validation/opened-evaluation ledgers permitted by the charter.
A2 reports distinct records, post-BOS positions, supported-token counts, frequency strata, repeated exposures, and exact sampler draws.
No fit-bank count or support set is chosen using final evaluation answers.

training_geometry_and_schedule.geometry_gate: Verify actual all-valid context geometry, including the reported 192-versus-128 crop distinction, before freezing counts. No silent geometry substitution.
training_geometry_and_schedule.exact_update_count_freeze: Root/A2 freezes one exact count before fitting; all four arms use that same count.
training_geometry_and_schedule.schedule: Cosine decay, AdamW, base learning rate 2e-4, weight_decay=0, gradient_clip_norm=1.0, seed 4010; no staging schedule, teacher ranking, search, or A2 fallback.
training_geometry_and_schedule.expanded_bank_coverage_reason: The A2 reviewed 12,000-update baseline draws 6,144,000 positions per arm; with the estimated 1.24M expanded valid positions this is about five passes. Before freeze, require at least six and target six-to-ten position exposures using the verified count; increase updates within the bound if needed.
training_geometry_and_schedule.validation_selection: Earliest maximum of a predeclared domain-balanced public token-accuracy score among checkpoints every 1,000 updates; ties choose earliest.
training_geometry_and_schedule.source_interface: Fit rows and natural-validation clips use separately declared context widths; fitting uses verified all-valid geometry and final clips retain 127 post-BOS positions.

expanded_position_exposure_requirement.freeze_rule: Compute from A2-bound expanded valid-position count before fitting; no silent underexposure.

training_geometry_and_schedule.checkpoint_grid_rule: Same fixed grid for all four arms; use the fixed public diagnostic subset for curves and full-bank fit metrics at start/end, avoiding full expanded-bank scoring every 100 updates.
training_geometry_and_schedule.recommended_schedule_receipt: A2 fixed-control review proposes 12,000 updates; exact geometry/exposure and final count remain pending root freeze.

directional_readout.goal: Genuine token-specific scoring-vector direction freedom beyond gain/bias-only calibration and a global absorbable transform.
directional_readout.base_readout: Published FP32 public embedding/readout E remains the immutable anchor for all vocabulary rows.
directional_readout.parameterization: For supported rows S only, E_prime[S] = E[S] + A @ B, with A shape [|S|, 32] and B shape [32, 2048]; rows outside S equal E exactly.
directional_readout.initialization: A is zero-initialized; B starts from a deterministic public orthonormal basis generated with seed 4010 and is trainable from the first update. No truth or private model input.
directional_readout.optimizer: Directional A and B use the same declared optimizer opportunity and base learning-rate schedule as the decoder in every directional arm.
directional_readout.regularization: Proposed 1e-4 weighted L2 on A rows using (1 + 4/sqrt(count_v)) plus 1e-4 L2 on B-B0; count_v comes from fitting data only.
directional_readout.safety_bound: Proposed per-row update-norm cap 0.5 x ||E_v||2, checked before serialization; exact bound requires root/capacity review.
directional_readout.support_definition: S is every vocabulary row with positive fitting-bank count; absent rows have no adapter parameters and remain the base readout.
directional_readout.deployment: One readout artifact containing E plus A/B support updates; full-vocabulary current-H-only argmax, with no routing or search.
structural_checks: Unsupported rows are tensor-equivalent to the public anchor.
Updates are not constrained to scalar gain/bias or one global transform; non-collinear token-row updates are checked on public/synthetic diagnostics.
Support IDs, counts, adapter tensors, optimizer state, and serialized artifact sizes are recorded separately.

validation.panel: Opened TRR-0009 matched public natural panel, proposed as TRR-0010 public development only.
validation.metric: Equal-domain-weighted natural token accuracy: mean(Finance token accuracy, Pile token accuracy); target conditions remain paired within source.
validation.checkpoint_rule: Earliest maximum at the declared checkpoint interval; no final truth is opened for this selection.
validation.bank_exclusion: Validation records and derived rows are excluded from both fitting banks and the final natural panel.
validation.secondary: The inherited 48-record style-balanced development panel is secondary diagnostic context only, not the checkpoint-selection primary.
validation.fit_vs_validation_geometry: Fit context width 192; natural validation clip width 128 with 127 scored post-BOS positions.

a1_a2_common_subset.denominator_statement: A1, A2, all four TRR-0010 arms, and the unchanged reference use the same 256 source records (128 Finance, 128 Pile) and two paired target conditions; source records, not target observations, are the bootstrap unit.

final_evaluation.roles: One final natural panel is selected once after methods and exclusion ledgers are frozen. No repeated confirmation panels or outcome-driven expansion.
metrics: exact recovery of all 127 post-BOS positions per clip
final_evaluation.exclusions: All known fitting, validation, opened-evaluation, TRR-0009, and approved other-study ledgers; no P03 holdout or private workspace access.
final_evaluation.panel_size_rationale: Upper end of the resource-dependent 64–128/domain anchor range; 128/domain keeps the A1-to-A2 gap denominator explicit while retaining a bounded one-panel run.

useful_outcome_proposal.fixed_control_selection: No posthoc fixed-arm winner: expanded_directional must clear both expanded_fixed (matched data) and current_fixed (continued-training control) on the declared useful route; report both control-specific bounds.

gap_closure.formula: closure_m = (M_candidate - M_A1) / (M_A2 - M_A1), computed per source-record bootstrap draw.
gap_closure.unknown_rule: If A2 <= A1 or the A1-to-A2 gap is below its visibility floor, gap closure is UNKNOWN and cannot support promotion.
gap_closure.same_metric_requirement: A useful route clears both its absolute candidate-versus-fixed threshold and its A1-to-A2 closure threshold; exact and token routes remain separate.

useful_outcome_proposal.family_rule: At most one exact and one token useful route are predeclared, each route alpha 0.025; no pooled domains, target conditions, or metric families.
useful_outcome_proposal.interpretation: Useful result is mechanism evidence for this crossed study only. It does not automatically replace the reference, retrain, or expand the panel.
useful_outcome_proposal.control_requirement: Both fixed controls are required for a useful primary claim; the four-arm interaction remains descriptive if either control comparison is inconclusive.

safeguards_and_cost.qualification: Qualify the largest expanded-directional cell and serialized adapter before the full matrix with a fail-closed memory/time guard; stop on allocator, driver, or output-equivalence anomalies.
safeguards_and_cost.streaming: Public activation generation and expanded-bank preparation are chunked; no unbounded resident corpus or artifact expansion.

resource_estimate_from_published_trr0009.directional_adapter_rank32_fp32_paramete: (support_rows + 2048) * 32 parameters; exact support_rows and optimizer memory are measured after A2 preparation.
resource_estimate_from_published_trr0009.interpretation: Published peaks are qualification references, not guarantees. Expanded activations and directional state require a fresh preflight and representative qualification before a full run.

coordination_status.agent_two: A2 accepts the opened TRR-0009 matched-public 384-record panel as a proposed validation selector, subject to binding record/sequence hashes and excluding parent/derived rows from bank additions.
coordination_status.capacity: Pending verification of all-valid 192-versus-128 crop geometry, current-bank controlled replacements, directional adapter implementation, and resource qualification.

Exact optimizer update count (A2 baseline 12,000; bounded 12,000–20,000) before fitting.
